title: Townhouse at Villa Park by NEXT
description: A premium villa in a gated community with its own plot, 6 minutes from the sea — for $360,000. Designer finishing and premium-class furniture, the Botanical Garden is nearby. Location: the villa is in Chakvi — a quiet, ecologically clean area. 6 minutes on foot to the sea, 5 minutes by car to the Botanical Garden, 17 minutes by car to central Batumi. Convenient for families with children: a new kindergarten is next to the community, and a large school with a Russian-language section is 3 minutes away by car. About the property: the villa has an area of 145.4 m² over 2 floors. Layout: a spacious kitchen-living room, two bedrooms, a study, three bathrooms and a terrace. The windows offer a stunning view of the mountains. The plot is 167 m², enclosed by a hedge, with parking for two cars. About the community: Villa Park by NEXT is a premium-class gated community of just 14 villas — maximum privacy and quiet. The grounds are landscaped, with a promenade and beautiful evening lighting, 24/7 security and a checkpoint, and a pool with lounge areas. Price: $360,000. Eligible for a residence permit.
